purpose: Keep scheduler/provider delivery jitter separate from reasoning-worker utilization and from the local normal-close offset so P0 diagnosis does not blame the wrong layer.

observations.source: automation run context and durable successor observation
automation run context plus generation-matched BOOT_STARTED

interpretation: The scheduler/provider boundary is not an exact wall-clock handoff boundary even under exact_schedule. Epoch 83 was observed 1 minute 43 seconds (103 seconds) after its due, which is larger than the local normal-close offset of exactly 1 minute (60 seconds). These are different quantities: the local rearm must remain exact and live-verified, while provider delivery is measured as an external delay. Utilization measurement uses actual worker/successor observations; expected due remains a fencing/recovery reference.
next_action: Append comparable normal successor expected/observed pairs. Do not tune from only three heterogeneous samples. Keep P0-B split into local exact rearm correctness and separately observed provider delivery/startup latency.
